verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox's software is a cloud service, and self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS platform of this kind, so the axis applies. The evidence shows the product is accessed only through the vendor's cloud, even for mail center operators ('Simply log in to your account via our secure cloud'). There is no self-hostable distribution, on-premises option or source release, and white-labeling is a branding feature, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
